title: Operator-backed EKS provisioner: lifecycle hooks, ephemeral canary upgrades, and automated rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Replace the existing imperative bootstrapping scripts with a single Terraform module that installs and manages a small control-plane operator (Operator SDK) responsible for EKS control-plane lifecycle tasks in Redwood Private VPCs. The operator will coordinate safe upgrades using ephemeral canary clusters, perform preflight health validations, surface KPIs to Console, and trigger automated rollback on SLO regressions. The Terraform module must remain idempotent, support cross-account KMS key wiring for secrets, and expose feature flags for canary strategies (ephemeral vs. blue/green).

Scope:
- Terraform module to deploy operator manifests and RBAC, configure IRSA, and wire to an operator controller image (internal registry).
- Operator responsibilities: create ephemeral canary stacks, run synthetic load/SMOKE tests, gather SLO metrics (latency/p95, attach/creation failures), report status, and promote or rollback control plane manifests.
- Preflight validations in Terraform for networking, KMS key policies, and service-linked role presence.
- Observability: export upgrade traces and metrics to Console/OTel (upgrade_duration_seconds, canary_failures_total, rollback_count).
- Policy: allow customers to opt into automatic rollback, or require manual approval via Console.
- Tests: unit/integration for Terraform modules, e2e using a synthetic tenant harness, and chaos tests for partial AZ failures.

Non-goals: full replacement of existing fleet orchestration, making operator responsible for worker node lifecycle (outside current scope).
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module can be applied repeatedly without drift (idempotent) in a test VPC
Operator image and manifests are installed with correct IRSA roles and cross-account KMS access configured when provided
Upgrade flow: create ephemeral canary cluster, run smoke harness, promote control-plane manifests to primary on success
Automated rollback triggers when SLOs degrade beyond configured thresholds and emits rollback_count metric
Upgrade events and metrics are visible in Redwood Console (per-tenant upgrade trace with timestamps)
Documentation: module README, operator runbook, and run-e2e checklist added to Confluence/Drive links
tasks: Design: write operator contract and API surface (CustomResourceDefinitions) for canary, promote, rollback actions
Terraform: new module terraform/priv-eks-operator that creates Namespace, ServiceAccount, IRSA, ClusterRoleBindings, and HelmRelease/resource for operator
Security: design KMS cross-account role mapping and add preflight checks for key policy visibility
Observability: add OTel exporter config and metrics definitions; wire to Console metrics ingestion
CI: add terraform fmt/validate, terratest e2e job, and operator unit test job to GitHub Actions
E2E: synthetic tenant harness that runs a full upgrade cycle and validates rollback behavior
Docs: README, upgrade runbook, and customer-facing opt-in toggle documentation
Deploy: staged rollout to staging infra and run canary upgrades against a non-prod tenant
